summary: NextSync 0.2.8: the Add Folder dialog now actually opens (fixed an AttributeError on Adw.EntryRow) and the in-app Settings/About icons render white.
changelog: The Add Folder dialog now opens: it called set_placeholder_text, which Adw.EntryRow does not provide, raising AttributeError before the dialog was shown. The remote folder field now carries an informative title instead.
The Settings and About icons in the app header now use a fixed white stroke so they render white on the header bar like the rest.
